subject: Post-demo: LumenPay security intake and buying timeline
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@lumenpay.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: LumenPay security intake and buying timeline

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the 30-minute demo this morning. Good discussion; appreciate the clarity on the payment flows and where you’d like Redwood to sit in the stack. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary (quick)
- Primary use case: real-time payout routing + compliance labeling for domestic payouts.
- Technical touchpoints: inference API for NLP routing, S3 for logs, Auth via your existing Okta tenant.
- Big risks you flagged: PII handling in logs, retention policy, and procurement timelines.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Stakeholder list — can you confirm the economic buyer and procurement/legal contacts? I noted Priya as product lead; please confirm who owns the budget.
2) Security kickoff — I’ve attached a short Redwood intake questionnaire (redwood-security-questionnaire.xlsx). If you can return the PDF with answers, we’ll have Security triage it and outline evidence requests.
3) Timeline proposal — we’ll aim to complete the security review first pass by 8/28 so procurement can start redlines the week of 8/30. Does that align with your procurement window?
4) Proposed meeting — security kickoff (30 min): Tue 8/18 or Wed 8/19 afternoon PST.

Attachments: redwood-security-questionnaire.xlsx (fillable), MAP-template.xlsx (mutual action plan template)

Mutual action plan (high level)
- Week of 8/17: intake completed; Security kickoff held.
- Week of 8/24: evidence collection; initial review.
- Week of 8/31: procurement redline window; legal touchpoint.

If you confirm stakeholders and one of the proposed times I’ll send a calendar invite and loop in our security lead (Monica) and AE (Aditya).

Best,
Chloe

Thanks — will watch for the invite.

Chloe / team —

I reviewed the lumenpay-security-initial.pdf and did a quick pass on the redwood-security-questionnaire. High-level notes:

Systems in-scope (initial)
- Inference API endpoints (real-time routing service)
- App servers handling webhook callbacks
- S3 buckets used for audit logs (ingestion pipeline)

Systems out-of-scope (for now)
- Analytics cluster (batch processing)
- Internal BI dashboards

Evidence we will request
- Recent SOC2 Type II report (if available)
- Network diagram + CIDR/IPs for allowlist
- Data retention policy and purge scripts for PII
- Encryption-at-rest details for S3 buckets

Risks / blockers
- Their PDF indicates PII in logs; we'll need to confirm whether PII is redacted before it leaves their edge. If not, ask for a narrow allowlist window and test account.
- Procurement timeline (8/25 redline) is tight — we should prioritize a concise evidence bundle vs. a full audit.

Proposed next steps
1) Meet Tue 8/18 2pm PST for 30-min kickoff (Chloe to send invite). I’ll bring a short evidence checklist and a first-pass filled questionnaire.
2) I’ll prepare a two-page evidence pack template (security-evidence-plan.md attached) we can share with Priya/Emily.
3) Ask LumenPay for infra diagram and network block by EOD Wed 8/19 so we can attempt the first test window on 8/24.

I’ll attach the partially filled questionnaire in the invite.

—Monica
